Patch Set 5:

(10 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Problematic, see inline comments. The switch from cfs_hash to the xarray drops the reference that cfs_hash_add_unique()->hs_get() used to take on insert, but class_export_put() calls were kept (and two new ones added) on the removal side. The result is several unbalanced puts on obd_export, at least one of which fires on every server-side export teardown. The reference model for obd_gen_ids needs to be decided and applied consistently: either xa_insert() is paired with class_export_get() and every erase site with a put, or no reference is held and every put on that path goes away.
